title: Detroit Public Schools Policies
description: Learn about Detroit Public Schools Policies and leaders.
body:
# Detroit Public Schools Community District

![](/media/uploads/2026/10/Detroit_Public_Schools_logo.png)

- The district gives procurement contract [preferences](https://web.archive.org/web/20260814172437/https:/www.detroitk12.org/services-and-supports/services/procurement) based on sexual identity and sexual preference by giving LGBTQ-owned businesses priority in contracting.
- The [strategic plan](https://web.archive.org/web/20260814172514/https:/www.detroitk12.org/about-dpscd/strategic-plan) for the district that determines the goals for graduates includes making them “informed advocates for racial equity, social justice, and human rights worldwide, which compels them to stand up to injustice through informed civic participation as adults.”
- One of the district’s [goals](https://web.archive.org/web/20260814172514/https:/www.detroitk12.org/about-dpscd/strategic-plan) includes “culture initiatives” for staff, “including equity and inclusion work, that attract and retain diverse talent.”
- The [district states](https://web.archive.org/web/20260725030004/https:/www.detroitk12.org/about-dpscd/policies/civil-rights-and-compliance) “Schools cannot share a student’s gender identity or sexual orientation without permission” - no exclusion for parents.
- Detroit Board of Education [policy allows](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/c141bfa4-47af-43c8-83df-5de187233948/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/Detroit-sports-by-gender-identity.png?language=en) sports participation by gender identity. If a student is taking cross-sex hormones, they are permitted to play on the team that matches their chosen gender identity not biological sex.
- DPSCD’s Detroit History [curriculum](https://web.archive.org/web/20260814172541/https:/www.detroitk12.org/academics/core-curriculum/social-studies) requires students to learn about the DPSCD Citizen Manual in 10th grade civics. This [document](https://web.archive.org/web/20260209121022/https:/citizenmanual.com/lessons/detroit-civic-engagement-today/) is filled with social justice propaganda including pushing Black Lives Matter and the narrative of voter suppression. The manual teaches that “Voter suppression continued to be a challenge in the U.S. since the laws of the Jim Crow South especially as it re-emerged into mainstream consciousness in the 21st century.” Anti-police rhetoric is also found in the document. It claims, “Much like other marginalized groups in Detroit, the LGBTQ community has had an antagonistic relationship with police over the years and continued discrimination against LGBTQ people today increases the likelihood that they will come into contact with police.” On immigration, the document says, “the city of Detroit did not declare itself a Sanctuary City but Detroit Public Schools Community District did draft and approve a resolution declaring itself a “Safe Zone” where ICE would not be welcomed without prior notice and parents would be able to keep their immigrant status private.”
